Question
========
What distinguishes pre-distribution from redistribution?

Answerlist
----------
* Pre-distribution shapes market incomes before taxes, for example through bargaining power, pay rules, and ownership
* Pre-distribution means higher income taxes
* Pre-distribution only concerns inheritance
* There is no difference

Solution
========
Redistribution corrects outcomes through taxes and transfers; pre-distribution makes the distribution of market income itself more equal.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
